description: Montées-descentes par commune en gares des Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in Open Data Région Pays de la Loire, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région des Pays de la Loire. Statistiques de montées-descentes par commune en gares des Pays de la Loire (moyennes journalières). Pour plus d'informations: La Région autorité organisatrice. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are transport. The portal shows 1,369 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-01-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
